status: Exact Rademacher coefficient check plus correlated synthetic trace; no detector experiment
theorem: For Yk=sum_l>=0 H_l eps_{k-l} X_{k-l}+Zk, iid balanced signs independent of entire joint pre-code X,Z, positive-lag demod covariance is H0 GammaX(m) H0^dagger. X/Z correlation allowed. No need to commute filtering and demodulation.
scope: Stable summable causal discrete LTI filter or finite FIR
Full-rank nonzero current tap for full-state recovery; known pure delay can be aligned
This is a sampled/held prefilter signal model. Continuous within-exposure dynamics need an exposure-aware feature model.
No code-dependent state evolution, feedback, sensor law or switching transients
Noncausal filters retain crossed term H_m GammaX(-m) H_-m^dagger
No finite-sample guarantee follows from exact coefficient cancellation
thermal_metric_from_positive_lags: If a complete thermal occupation shift gives DeltaC=Delta_n I and H0 invertible, DeltaGamma_m=T^m M_eff Delta_n; T=DeltaGamma_(m+1) DeltaGamma_m^-1 and M_eff=T^-m DeltaGamma_m/Delta_n. Zero-lag detector memory does not supply this metric.
imperfect_two_state_modulation: For stable repeatable physical maps A+B eps before the filter, balanced demodulation selects H0 B as the effective signal map; an uncoded A channel vanishes from positive-lag code projection but increases variance. Unknown B needs calibration.
